cmd:
cat > /root/autodeploy.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
cd /root/Shylo_Oleksandr || exit 1
BEFORE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git pull --rebase --autostash --quiet
AFTER=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
if [ "$BEFORE" != "$AFTER" ]; then
  /root/Shylo_Oleksandr/venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt
  systemctl restart mybot.service
  systemctl restart cmdrunner.service
fi
EOF
chmod +x /root/autodeploy.sh && echo done
